desc: Parse the input $N, M$ and the list of constraints $(X_i, Y_i, Z_i)$.
Initialize a DSU structure with $N$ elements, maintaining `parent` and `xor_to_parent` arrays, where `xor_to_parent[i]` stores $A_i \oplus A_{\text{root}}$.
Implement a `find(i)` function that performs path compression and updates `xor_to_parent` so that it correctly reflects the XOR distance to the new root.

If they are in different components, unite them by setting the parent of one root to the other and calculating the required `xor_to_parent` for the new child root to satisfy $A_{X_i} \oplus A_{Y_i} = Z_i$.
If they are in the same component, verify that the existing XOR distance between $X_i$ and $Y_i$ equals $Z_i$. If not, print -1 and exit.
After processing all constraints without conflict, construct the result array $A$:
For each root in the DSU, the value $A_{\text{root}}$ is effectively 0 (minimal non-negative).
For every node $i$, calculate $A_i = \text{xor\_to\_root}(i) \oplus A_{\text{root}}$. Since $A_{\text{root}} = 0$, $A_i$ is simply the stored XOR distance to the root.
Print the resulting sequence $A$ separated by spaces.
